source.mappingBasis: Declared model/actual-call scope, not hardware counter data

assumptions: Group totals sum explicitly evaluated physical work and traffic. Replicated local useful work is not the logical model numerator for MFU.
Logical compute is evaluated once from the expanded graph and kept in model_useful scopes separately from physical group_total costs.
Node seconds use the slowest participating device. Model seconds use the declared serial-barrier makespan, including named communications; device seconds are never summed as wall time.
Modules aggregate their declared expanded graph leaves, including graph-native communications. Plan-level communications belong to the model; they are not implicitly assigned to a module.
Unplaced or incomplete local equations remain unknown. Network-only communication does not imply zero HBM, local reduction or staging cost.
Measurement example:executed:fusion:single; time kind=single, count=1; per-call equivalent 2 second.

Executed-work utilization uses declared physical executed operations and unique matching peak capability on each actual device. It is separate from model-useful MFU and is not a measured hardware counter.

Modules aggregate their declared expanded graph leaves, including graph-native communications. Plan-level communications belong to the model; they are not implicitly assigned to a module.
Unplaced or incomplete local equations remain unknown. Network-only communication does not imply zero HBM, local reduction or staging cost.
Measurement example:executed:fusion:single, input cd033fc3cfd0331a01809b99cfbd024f9c8656744b0424d3cbacbf4146a30b4c; time kind=single, count=1.
